args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: From the deployment history, v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production. (v2.3.1-rc was only a staging release and unhealthy, so it wasn't a candidate.)

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`).

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created INC-0001 titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" describing the failure and the rollback action, which paged the on-call engineer.

5. **Verified recovery**: Confirmed checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate down to 0.002.
